slides.title: Why These Principles Are Non-Negotiable
bullets: MSL credibility rests on ethical and scientific practice principles
Applied consistently across all research-related activity
Not bureaucratic add-ons, but what separates Medical Affairs from Commercial
They sustain long-term trust with the scientific community

slides.title: Investigator Independence, Always
bullets: Design, execution, analysis, and interpretation stay with the investigator
True across IIS, registries, and observational studies alike
The sponsor cannot condition support on favorable results
Applies whether published conclusions favor the product or not

slides.title: A Strict Wall From Commercial
bullets: Research support must never link, even implicitly, to prescription volume
Study information must not be shared with commercial teams for sales use
Approval decisions run through independent scientific review committees

slides.title: Transparency and Public Registration
bullets: Trials, and increasingly relevant observational studies, register publicly
On platforms like ClinicalTrials.gov or the EU Clinical Trials Register
Registration happens before recruitment begins
Results publish regardless of favorable or unfavorable outcome

slides.title: Good Clinical Practice as the Standard
bullets: GCP is the international standard for ethical trial conduct
Governs design, conduct, recording, and reporting of human studies
Protects participants' rights, safety, and wellbeing
Underpins the reliability of the data generated

slides.title: Honest Conflict-of-Interest Management
bullets: The most day-to-day relevant principle for an MSL
Every collaboration, funding, or support relationship must be transparent
Declared by both investigator and company
In publications and to relevant ethics committees

slides.title: Integrity, Visit After Visit
bullets: These principles matter most when no one is supervising
Applied consistently, study after study, visit after visit
They build a reputation no communication strategy can substitute

takeaway.title: Independence, separation from commercial, transparency, GCP, and honest conflict management are what make Medical Affairs credible
bullets: Investigator independence and commercial separation are the core wall
Public registration and GCP protect the integrity of the evidence itself
Consistent, unsupervised application is what earns lasting credibility
